title: Effects of Extreme Heat Events on Crop Revenues for U.S. Corn and Soybeans
abstract: Extreme weather events have nuanced implications for crop producers. While they can reduce local yields, widespread production losses often drive price increases. This study presents a panel approach that accounts for the price–yield correlation to assess the impact of such events on crop revenues, focusing on U.S. corn and soybeans. It conducts two key analyses: (1) quantifying the revenue impacts of the historic 1988 and 2012 U.S. heatwaves and (2) examining the implications of climate change on crop revenue variability. The results show that compensatory price increases often substantially offset yield losses, especially when price responsiveness to supply shocks is strong. In particular, U.S. corn in 2012 and soybeans in 1988 saw crop revenues rise by more than 8% compared to normal weather conditions, whereas U.S. corn in 1988 and soybeans in 2012 experienced decreases of no more than 4%. The study highlights the importance of crop‐specific and time‐varying price responsiveness to supply shocks. Furthermore, it demonstrates that if growing season weather during 1997–2019 had exhibited the volatility projected for 2036–2065 under a moderate emissions scenario, revenue variability for corn and soybeans in median U.S. counties would have increased by more than 60%, with more pronounced impacts in regions outside the major Corn Belt. These findings underscore the significant economic risks posed by climate change–induced variability in agricultural revenues.
abstract_zh: 极端天气事件对作物生产者的收入影响错综复杂。虽然它们会降低局部产量，但大范围的产量损失往往会推动价格上涨。本研究提出一种面板方法，以考虑价格与产量之间的相关性，从而评估此类事件对作物收入的影响，研究对象为美国玉米和大豆。研究开展了两项关键分析：（1）量化历史上1988年和2012年美国热浪对收入的影响；（2）考察气候变化对作物收入波动的影响。结果表明，补偿性价格上涨往往能大幅抵消产量损失，尤其是在价格对供给冲击反应较强的情况下。具体而言，2012年的美国玉米和1988年的大豆，其作物收入相较正常天气条件增加了8%以上；而1988年的美国玉米和2012年的大豆，收入减少不超过4%。本研究强调，针对特定作物且随时间变化的价格对供给冲击的反应程度十分重要。此外，研究还表明，如果1997至2019年的生长季天气表现出中等排放情景下2036至2065年预计的波动性，那么美国中位数县的玉米和大豆收入波动将增加60%以上，且在主要玉米带以外的地区影响更为显著。这些发现凸显了气候变化引起的农业收入波动所带来的重大经济风险。

title: The Impact of Wildfire Smoke Exposure on Crime
abstract: Using crime data from 21 major U.S. cities spanning 2007–20, this paper studies the impacts of wildfire smoke on crimes. Wildfire smoke increases concentrations of multiple pollutants simultaneously, which makes it important to use wildfire smoke as a single, unified treatment variable. Our results show that wildfire smoke significantly increases crime, with particularly notable impacts on violent and drug-related crimes. Wildfire smoke leads to increases of 0.49% in overall crime, 0.88% in violent offenses, and 1.35% in drug-related crimes. Our findings show that crime rates surge on the first and second consecutive days of smoke exposure but diminish from the third day onward, possibly due to adaptive behaviors to limit smoke exposure. Lastly, the effects of air quality alerts vary across types of crimes: overall and violent crimes fall but drug-related crimes increase on smoky days with alert days compared to without alert.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2007至2020年美国21个主要城市的犯罪数据，研究野火烟雾对犯罪的影响。野火烟雾会同时提高多种污染物的浓度，因此有必要将野火烟雾作为单一的综合处理变量加以使用。我们的结果表明，野火烟雾显著增加了犯罪，对暴力犯罪和毒品相关犯罪的影响尤为明显。野火烟雾导致总体犯罪增加0.49%，暴力犯罪增加0.88%，毒品相关犯罪增加1.35%。研究发现，在连续暴露于烟雾的第一天和第二天，犯罪率激增，但从第三天起有所下降，这可能是由于人们采取了限制烟雾暴露的适应性行为。最后，空气质量预警的效果因犯罪类型而异：在烟雾天且发布预警时，总体犯罪和暴力犯罪下降，而毒品相关犯罪则增加，相较于未发布预警的情形而言。

title: Field-Level Crop Choice Responses to Weather-Induced Yield Shocks in the U.S. Corn Belt
Industry-Adjusted Book-to-Market Ratio and Value Premium
Effects of Water Surplus on Prevented Planting in the U.S. Corn Belt for Corn and Soybeans
abstract: Record-high prevented planting of staple crops such as corn and soybeans in the United States (US) Corn Belt due to heavy rainfall in recent years has spurred concern over crop production, as growing evidence suggests winter and spring precipitation extremes will occur more frequentlyin the coming decades. Using county-level data, we examine the effects of planting-season water surplus—precipitation minus evaporative demand—on prevented planting of corn and soybeans in the US Corn Belt. Using monthly water surplus data, we show significant impacts of excess moisture on preventing planting and suggest a 58%–177% increase in prevented planting during the months of April–June per standard deviation increase in water surplus. Downscaled climate change projections are used to estimate future changes in prevented planting during the mid-century (2036–2065) under the moderate emission scenario (RCP4.5). Our model predicts a decrease in prevented planting of approximately 111,000 acres (12%) for corn and 80,000 acres (16%) for soybeans in the US Corn Belt, relative to historical levels from 1950 to 2005. However, if we consider only precipitation and disregard evaporative demand, the alternative model indicates an increase of approximately 260,000 acres (30%) for corn and 86,000 acres (19%) for soybeans. Geographically, we find that prevented planting will slightly increase in some parts of Iowa, Minnesota, and Wisconsin and generally decrease in the other parts of the US Corn Belt. This work collectively highlights the value of incorporating water surplus data in assessing prevented-planting impacts and is the first known study to examine changing risk of prevented planting under future climate scenarios that may help inform adaptation efforts to avoid losses.
abstract_zh: 近年来，由于强降雨，美国玉米带的玉米和大豆等主要作物的未播种面积创下历史新高，引发了人们对作物生产的担忧。越来越多的证据表明，冬季和春季的极端降水在未来几十年将更加频繁地发生。本文利用县级数据，考察播种季节的水分盈余（降水减去蒸发需求）对美国玉米带玉米和大豆未播种面积的影响。利用月度水分盈余数据，我们发现过量水分对延误播种有显著影响，并表明在4月至6月期间，水分盈余每增加一个标准差，未播种面积将增加58%至177%。我们使用降尺度的气候变化预估，在中等排放情景（RCP4.5）下估计本世纪中期（2036至2065年）未播种面积的变化。模型预测，相对于1950至2005年的历史水平，美国玉米带玉米未播种面积将减少约11.1万英亩（12%），大豆减少约8万英亩（16%）。然而，如果仅考虑降水而忽略蒸发需求，替代模型则显示玉米未播种面积将增加约26万英亩（30%），大豆增加约8.6万英亩（19%）。从地理分布来看，爱荷华州、明尼苏达州和威斯康星州的部分地区未播种面积将略有增加，而美国玉米带其他地区总体上将有所减少。本研究共同凸显了在评估未播种面积影响时纳入水分盈余数据的价值，并且是首个考察未来气候情景下未播种风险变化的研究，有助于为避免损失的适应性努力提供参考。
